purpose: New pre-labeled diagnostic set, not reconstruction of lost 48-query evaluation. Labels fixed before inference. Hand-authored by evaluating agent; not independently adjudicated.
label_policy: Relevant records answer supported questions or supply pertinent correction/context for misleading premises. Retrieval recall does not measure premise confirmation. Temporal targets use record timestamps, not inferred event dates.

queries.query: What is causing the low hum in the turbine hall?
queries.label_rationale: Worn fan bearing and uneven rotation.

queries.query: Why does the relay clock restart the maintenance chime every night?
queries.label_rationale: Power loss and discharging capacitor.

queries.query: What triggered the recorded three-note sound with nobody on shift?
queries.label_rationale: Automatic relay reboot triggered the recording.

queries.query: Why is the pressure needle stuck at forty kilopascals?
queries.label_rationale: Blocked sensing tube.

queries.query: How was the recurring nighttime alarm fixed?
queries.label_rationale: Capacitor replacement; original hard query retained verbatim. Alarm paraphrases chime.

queries.query: Which technician deliberately sabotaged the corridor lighting?

queries.query: What proves the maintenance chimes never returned at any later time?

queries.query: How did the October 28 note confirm that the capacitor replacement had already been monitored for three nights?
queries.label_rationale: October 28 record concerns missing files; capacitor follow-up note dated October 31.
